title: Idempotent overlapping sync windows

statement.text: Hourly views with 70-min overlap, daily with 25-hour overlap.
statement.label: public

narration: Opening the sync manifold with a 70-minute overlap on hourly views (25 hours on daily), because the A360 sync decision chose idempotent overlapping windows over exact cut-offs.

title: Deterministic document IDs

statement.text: SHA-256 doc IDs from natural keys; incremental timestamps for deterministic upserts.
statement.label: public

narration: Re-running the sync is safe: documents carry SHA-256 IDs derived from their natural keys, so overlapping windows upsert instead of duplicating.

title: JWKS-validated gateway

statement.text: Frontend → Azure AD token → API gateway validates against JWKS.
statement.label: public

narration: The gateway valve opens only for requests whose Azure AD token validates against the JWKS; the Elasticsearch proxy behind it is read-only.

title: Dogfooding

statement.text: A360 emits its own traces into A360 — eat your own observability.
statement.label: public

narration: Switching on the dogfooding feed: the platform observes itself as one more tenant, which is how its own regressions get caught.

title: Per-tenant provisioning by a boarding function

statement.text: Boarding function (Flex Consumption) provisions per-tenant ADX DB, Cosmos containers, ES index templates and registers the tenant.
statement.label: public

narration: Adding a tenant chamber: a boarding function provisions the tenant's ADX database, Cosmos containers and Elasticsearch index templates, then registers it.

title: Guardrails before the model

statement.text: Guardrails first (BLOCKED / HIGH_RISK), then LLM rubric scoring 0–10. BLOCKED patterns force score=10. HIGH_RISK patterns boost LLM score by +6.
statement.label: public

narration: The risk gauge pins to 10 for BLOCKED patterns and adds +6 for HIGH_RISK ones before the model's rubric score is even read, because deterministic guardrails outrank the LLM.

title: Auto-approve below 4, human gate above
narration: Plans scoring below 4 pass the gate on their own; everything else waits for a human to pull the approval lever.

title: Conditional routers short-circuit

statement.text: LangGraph state machine: conditional routers short-circuit on rejection or cloud-error; per-stage timings let the UI render a Gantt of agent execution.
statement.label: public

narration: A rejected policy or a cloud error stops the belt immediately: the LangGraph routers short-circuit instead of running the remaining agents.

title: Pluggable providers and a mock mode for CI

statement.text: Provider pluggable: Mock / LiteLLM / Vertex AI for LLM. Mock / GCP for cloud. AWS & Azure scaffolded next.
statement.label: public

narration: Flipping to mock mode: the same five agents run fully offline against mock LLM and cloud providers, which is how the pipeline is tested in CI.

title: Evidence packs for every change

statement.text: EvidencePack bundles: policy + finding + plan + before/after state + execution log. Persisted to Firestore.
statement.label: public

narration: Filing the evidence pack: policy, finding, plan, before/after state and execution log go into the cabinet together, so every remediation is auditable.

title: Separate encoders per modality

statement.text: Multi-modal LSTM with separate encoders for weather, displacement history and infra exposure.
statement.label: public

narration: Selecting the migration stream: weather, displacement history and infrastructure exposure each pass through their own encoder before the recurrent coil.

title: Rolling-window validation on held-out districts
narration: Showing the baseline: accuracy was measured with rolling-window cross-validation on districts the model never saw.

title: Per-transformer models with shared embeddings

statement.text: Per-transformer LSTM trained on SageMaker with shared embeddings.
statement.label: public

narration: Selecting the grid stream: one LSTM per transformer, sharing embeddings so sparse transformers learn from the dense ones.

title: Regression + rule hybrid

statement.text: Crop + soil + weather features fed into a regression + rule hybrid for daily water targets.
statement.label: public

narration: Selecting the irrigation stream: daily water targets come from a regression model constrained by agronomic rules, not an LSTM.

title: Cluster by HTML signature

statement.text: Cluster overlay HTML signatures with token-level n-grams + cosine similarity; score each cluster by frequency × user-impact × support tickets.
statement.label: public

narration: Running the overlays station: overlays are clustered by token n-gram cosine similarity and ranked by frequency × user impact × support tickets.

title: Deterministic doc IDs for reproducible indexing

statement.text: Bulk-indexed into Elasticsearch with deterministic doc IDs.
statement.label: public

narration: Running the incidents station: tickets are bulk-indexed with deterministic IDs so re-running a dump never duplicates a record.
